title: Google 黑五 1 年 100 刀，GPT 的土区 499plus 还续吗？
content_html:
@fyq 我自己问了 Gemini,搞定了原因，哈哈

Starting Black Friday (November 27): If you are currently on a free account (or not actively paying for a Google One/AI plan), you won't see the 50% off promo until Friday, November 27, when Google opens Black Friday offers to new subscribers.
